template.docs:
The `template` water heater platform allows you to create simple water heaters out of just a few actions and lambdas. Once defined, it will automatically appear in Home Assistant as a water heater entity and can be controlled through the frontend.

*See also: [Template Water Heater](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater/template)*

max_temperature.docs:
**float**: Override the maximum temperature shown in the frontend.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

min_temperature.docs:
**float**: Override the minimum temperature shown in the frontend.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

target_temperature_step.docs:
**float**: Override the temperature steps shown in the frontend.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

visual.docs:
Configuration for the frontend representation.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The water heater to control.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#water_heatercontrol-action)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name for the water heater. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: Manually set the icon to use for the water heater in the frontend.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

supported_modes.docs:
**list**: Static list of operation modes that will be exposed to the frontend (for example Home Assistant). When not specified, all modes supported by the platform are exposed. > **Note** > This option is platform-dependent. Not all water heater platforms allow configuring supported modes.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#base-water-heater-configuration)*

mode.docs:
**string**: The operation mode to set. See [Modes](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#water-heater-modes) for available options.

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#water_heatercontrol-action)*

target_temperature.docs:
**float**: The target temperature to set (e.g., `60.0`).

*See also: [Water Heater Component](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater#water_heatercontrol-action)*
